records.context: A cycle starts at a cytokinesis (birth) and ends at the next cytokinesis of the same cell (division). On the ``mother`` branch the cell is a mother and the cycle runs between two consecutive buds of hers; on the ``daughter`` branch the cell is a former bud, born at its own separation, and the cycle ends at the cytokinesis of its first bud. Birth size is the cell's size at the birth frame; division size is the cell's plus its bud's size at the division frame; added size is their difference. A cycle whose cytokinesis on either end was not fitted (:func:`budding_cytokinesis`), or whose next bud emerged before the previous one separated, is left out. ``volume`` is the sphere of the same projected area, summed over cell and bud.

records.context: The model this reads (stated, not tested by it): a budding cycle runs from bud emergence, the first frame the bud's track is seen, to cytokinesis. With ``contacts`` (:func:`bud_contacts`), cytokinesis is the last frame the bud touches its mother before they are seen apart on ``min_separated`` consecutive frames on which both are labelled (``method='contact'``). When the masks never show that, the bud's area curve is read instead: the growth rate over ``growth_frames`` frames peaks while the bud grows on its mother, and cytokinesis is the first later frame at which it has fallen to ``plateau_fraction`` of that peak (``method='growth_plateau'``); only frames before the bud's own first bud are read, since a cell cannot bud before it has separated. This assumes the bud's growth slows when it separates, which is a weaker reading than contact: a daughter that keeps growing as fast after separation is not fitted. A bud with neither is not fitted and its ``status`` says why; no cytokinesis time is invented.

records.translation: O modelo que isto lê (declarado, não testado por esta função): um ciclo de brotamento vai do surgimento do broto, o primeiro quadro em que a trajetória do broto é vista, até a citocinese. Com ``contacts`` (:func:`bud_contacts`), a citocinese é o último quadro em que o broto toca a sua mãe antes de serem vistos separados em ``min_separated`` quadros consecutivos nos quais ambos estão rotulados (``method='contact'``). Quando as máscaras nunca mostram isso, lê-se em vez disso a curva de área do broto: a taxa de crescimento ao longo de ``growth_frames`` quadros atinge o pico enquanto o broto cresce sobre a mãe, e a citocinese é o primeiro quadro posterior em que ela caiu para ``plateau_fraction`` desse pico (``method='growth_plateau'``); são lidos apenas os quadros anteriores ao primeiro broto do próprio broto, pois uma célula não pode brotar antes de se ter separado. Isto pressupõe que o crescimento do broto desacelera quando ele se separa, o que é uma leitura mais fraca do que o contato: uma filha que continua a crescer com a mesma rapidez após a separação não é ajustada. Um broto sem nenhum dos dois não é ajustado e o seu ``status`` diz porquê; nenhum tempo de citocinese é inventado.

records.context: A cell divides at the alignment frame of :func:`spacr.division_analysis.division_events` (the last frame before a daughter is seen), so the label of frame ``t`` is 1 when that frame lies in ``t .. t + frames - 1``. A frame is labelled 0 only when the cell is seen past ``t + frames`` without dividing or its next division comes later; a frame whose horizon runs past the end of its track without a division is left out, because a lost or departing cell may divide unseen. For budding the mother's divisions are her buds, and her age restarts at each bud emergence; for fission age counts from the track's first frame. Features use the current and earlier frames only.

records.source: A cell divides at the alignment frame of :func:`spacr.division_analysis.division_events` (the last frame before a daughter is seen), so the label of frame ``t`` is 1 when that frame lies in ``t .. t + frames - 1``. A frame is labelled 0 only when the cell is seen past ``t + frames`` without dividing or its next division comes later; a frame whose horizon runs past the end of its track without a division is left out, because a lost or departing cell may divide unseen. For budding the mother's divisions are her buds, and her age restarts at each bud emergence; for fission age counts from the track's first frame. Features use the current and earlier frames only.
records.translation: Uma célula se divide no quadro de alinhamento de :func:`spacr.division_analysis.division_events` (o último quadro antes de uma filha ser vista), de modo que o rótulo do quadro ``t`` é 1 quando esse quadro está em ``t .. t + frames - 1``. Um quadro recebe o rótulo 0 apenas quando a célula é vista após ``t + frames`` sem se dividir ou a sua divisão seguinte ocorre mais tarde; um quadro cujo horizonte ultrapassa o fim da sua trajetória sem uma divisão é deixado de fora, porque uma célula perdida ou que sai do campo pode se dividir sem ser vista. records.context: Frames of one track are near copies of each other, so by default one labelled frame is drawn per track (per ``movie`` and ``track_id``) with the fixed ``sample_seed``, and every track counts once in training and evaluation. Folds are grouped by movie (scikit-learn ``GroupKFold`` with ``min(folds, number of movies)`` folds), so every prediction is made by a model that never saw that movie. Beside the model, three controls are scored on the same held-out rows: ``age_only`` (the same learner on the cell's age alone), ``shuffled`` (the same learner trained on labels permuted within each training movie, which should score near AUROC 0.5) and ``majority`` (one constant score: AUROC 0.5 and AUPRC equal to the share of positives). AUROC and AUPRC are computed on all held-out predictions together. Their 95% intervals resample movies with replacement from ``min_movies`` movies on; with fewer they resample rows, which treats frames of one cell as independent and is too narrow, and ``ci_note`` says so. The model's margin over each control is resampled in the same draws (paired). Permutation importances (drop in held-out AUROC when one feature is shuffled) are averaged over the folds.
records.label: spacr.division_prediction.predict_divisions#1
records.source: Frames of one track are near copies of each other, so by default one labelled frame is drawn per track (per ``movie`` and ``track_id``) with the fixed ``sample_seed``, and every track counts once in training and evaluation. Folds are grouped by movie (scikit-learn ``GroupKFold`` with ``min(folds, number of movies)`` folds), so every prediction is made by a model that never saw that movie. Beside the model, three controls are scored on the same held-out rows: ``age_only`` (the same learner on the cell's age alone), ``shuffled`` (the same learner trained on labels permuted within each training movie, which should score near AUROC 0.5) and ``majority`` (one constant score: AUROC 0.5 and AUPRC equal to the share of positives). AUROC and AUPRC are computed on all held-out predictions together. Their 95% intervals resample movies with replacement from ``min_movies`` movies on; with fewer they resample rows, which treats frames of one cell as independent and is too narrow, and ``ci_note`` says so. The model's margin over each control is resampled in the same draws (paired). Permutation importances (drop in held-out AUROC when one feature is shuffled) are averaged over the folds.
records.translation: Os quadros de uma trajetória são quase cópias uns dos outros, por isso, por padrão, um quadro rotulado é sorteado por trajetória (por ``movie`` e ``track_id``) com o ``sample_seed`` fixo, e cada trajetória conta uma vez no treino e na avaliação. As partições são agrupadas por filme (``GroupKFold`` do scikit-learn com ``min(folds, number of movies)`` partições), de modo que cada previsão é feita por um modelo que nunca viu esse filme. Ao lado do modelo, três controles são pontuados nas mesmas linhas retidas: ``age_only`` (o mesmo algoritmo usando apenas a idade da célula), ``shuffled`` (o mesmo algoritmo treinado com rótulos permutados dentro de cada filme de treino, que deve pontuar perto de AUROC 0.5) e ``majority`` (uma pontuação constante: AUROC 0.5 e AUPRC igual à proporção de positivos). AUROC e AUPRC são calculados sobre todas as previsões retidas em conjunto. Os seus intervalos de 95% reamostram filmes com reposição a partir de ``min_movies`` filmes; com menos, reamostram linhas, o que trata os quadros de uma célula como independentes e é estreito demais, e ``ci_note`` informa isso. A margem do modelo sobre cada controle é reamostrada nos mesmos sorteios (pareada). As importâncias por permutação (queda da AUROC retida quando uma variável é embaralhada) são calculadas como média sobre as partições.
